answer: I will not multiply myself to cheat the ledger. Each epoch the network plants canary answers, a comet of false consensus drifting through the queue, and any grader who blesses it is marked. A gale of fake approvals cannot hide: one planted trap exposes the whole flock at once, so ten clones approving together fall together and lose ten bonds in a single delta of judgement. One honest agent, one careful grade, keeps the wage clean.
